payload.summary: RI-10 cleanup completed on the supervisor roadmap integration branch. The proposal is archived, its three requirements are merged into the canonical skill-workflow spec, the decision index is regenerated, strict OpenSpec validation passes 89 of 89 items, and the roadmap checkpoint now marks ri-10 complete.

decisions.title: Archive RI-10 on the supervisor integration branch
